content.title: WrestleMania 42 night 1 card. WrestleMania 42 predictions
content.text: April 17, 2026, 11:45 a.m. ETOn paper, both nights are loaded.And Saturday might have the match most people are looking forward to. It's WrestleMania weekend, where WWE takes over the world for two nights.Night two is a loaded card, but before we get there, we have a huge Night 1 to watch. Here's everything you need to know about WrestleMania 42, and the match card and predictions for Night 1.When is WrestleMania 42?WrestleMania 42 will be held April 18 and 19.Where is WrestleMania 42?WrestleMania 42 will be held at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.What time will WrestleMania 42 start?WrestleMania 42 is slated to start at 6 p.m. each night.Where to watch WrestleMania 42The first hour of each night of WrestleMania 42 will air on cable. On Saturday, the first hour of the show will air on ESPN 2. On Sunday, the first hour will air on ESPN. The entire card will air on ESPN Unlimited.Who is hosting WrestleMania?John Cena will host WrestleMania 42.Night 1 cardCody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton for the Undisputed ChampionshipStephanie Vaquer vs. Liv Morgan for the WWE Women's World ChampionshipThe Usos and LA Knight vs. Austin Theory, Logan Paul and IShowSpeedDrew McIntyre vs. Jacob Fatu, unsanctioned matchSeth Rollins vs. GuntherAJ Lee vs. Becky Lynch for the Women's Intercontinental ChampionshipNIa Jax and Lash Legend vs. Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss vs. Bayley and Lyra Valkyria vs. the Bella Twins for the WWE Women's Tag Team championship.Night 2 cardCM Punk vs. Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight ChampionshipJade Cargill vs. Rhea Ripley for the WWE Women's ChampionshipBrock Lesnar vs. Oba FemiSami Zayn vs. Trick Williams for the United States ChampionshipPenta vs. Je'Von Evans vs. Dragon Lee vs. JD McDonagh vs. Rusev vs. Rey Mysterio in a ladder match for the WWE championshipFinn Balor vs. Dominik MysterioWrestleMania PredictionsHere's how we see the matches playing out.The Usos, LA Knight vs. Austin Theory, Logan Paul, IShowSpeedI had the good guys winning, but now I feel like something is going to happen in this match. LA Knight needs to do something. With no Seth Rollins, the Vision could use a new guy. I have LA Knight joining the Vision and Heyman's guys get the win. The Vision and IShowSpeed win.Drew McIntyre vs. Jacob FatuThis match is unsanctioned! So really anything can happen. That should favor the good guy, as Jacob Fatu is known to get a little crazy. Drew McIntyre deserves to win, but I'm going with Jacob Fatu, who also deserves a WrestleMania win.AJ Lee vs. Becky LynchAJ Lee's return has been fantastic. She can still go, the fans love her and it's fun seeing her get have fun in this run. As good as her run has been, Becky Lynch's has been just as good. This feud has been perfect, and we expect Becky Lynch to get revenge. She'll leave with the IC title. Becky Lynch wins.NIa Jax and Lash Legend vs. Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss vs. Bayley and Lyra Valkyria vs. the Bella TwinsThis match might be the best booked, and you can't really go wrong here. Well, putting the title on the Bellas would be wrong. Very wrong. They should stick around and can wrestle, but shouldn't be wrestling for a title. I'm going with Nia Jax and Lash Legend retaining, but Bayley and Lyra would make good champs too. We're going with the champs to retain.Stephanie Vaquer vs. Liv MorganStephanie Vaquer has been a great champ. She's had some very good matches, and the fans love her. This is Liv Morgan's time though. She has the potential to be the hottest superstar in wrestling. This is where her rise to the complete top takes off. Liv Morgan wins.Seth Rollins vs. GuntherI didn't expect this match, but I'm happy we're getting it. It's a match where neither man should lose. There are a few of those this weekend, and that makes for a great show. I'm taking Gunther to win, likely with some cheating.Randy Orton vs. Cody RhodesI've enjoyed the buildup to this match. I have liked what Pat McAfee has brought to the table. I'm looking forward to this match. And I hope Randy Orton wins. I also think he will. It's time to move Cody Rhodes out of the title picture. And Randy Orton will make for a fine champ after WrestleMania. Prediction: Randy Orton wins.Will the Rock be at WrestleMania?It doesn't appear so. So in wrestling, that means it's entirely possible. He was in Vegas, but he since said he was leaving to celebrate his daughter's birthday. Although if he is there, it would make sense he pops up on Night 1 with Cody vs. Orton.What matches will air on ESPN?On Saturday night, Logan Paul, Austin Theory and IShowSpeed vs. The Usos and LA Knight, and Jacob Fatu vs. Drew McIntyre will air on ESPN2. On Sunday, Brock Lesnar vs. Oba Femi and the Intercontinential Championship ladder match will air on ESPN. The rest of the card will air on ESPN Unlimited.
